I ran `/code-conventions --review-pr` on `c82ccf019...HEAD` (39 files: the design-inconsistency work in the web shell and account views, plus a palette token in `packages/theme`). I generated the all-rules checklist and considered every item. Seven findings failed their rule check. No tracked files were changed. The only file written was the gitignored `docs/engineering/pr-self-review-checklist.generated.md`, and I didn't run tests or `gh`.

## Findings

| # | Rule | Where | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PROD-01 / UX-03 | `apps/web/src/styles/shadcn.css:34`, `:78` | `--accent` changes app-wide from neutral grey to green (light `#f5f5f5` → `#f0fdf4`, dark `#12ff8033` → `#052e16`). The PR only needs this for the dashboard and header pills, but every `focus:bg-accent` / `data-highlighted:bg-accent` surface picks it up. That includes all Select, DropdownMenu, ContextMenu and Combobox items (`components/ui/select.tsx:158`, `dropdown-menu.tsx:119/144/184/212`, `context-menu.tsx:121/146/166/191`, `combobox.tsx:153`) and global search (`AccountsSection.tsx:42`). Every keyboard- or hover-focused menu item in the app will now highlight green. `--accent` also becomes identical to `--sidebar-accent`. This needs an explicit design decision, or the green should be scoped to a separate token and the global one left alone. |
| 2 | FEAT-04 | `apps/web/src/components/ui/select.tsx:90-115`, `apps/web/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx:26,429,489` | This edits shared shadcn primitives. It adds a `showBackdrop` prop to `SelectContent`, and in `sidebar.tsx` it swaps the `SidebarTrigger` icon to `PanelRightIcon` and changes `SidebarHeader` padding and gap for every consumer. The rule requires the PR to state that this was coordinated with the design-system rewrite, or that no such PR is open. I can't check the PR description without `gh`, so this is unverified. |
| 3 | TEST-02 | `apps/web/src/hooks/useTopbarElevation.ts:21`, `:78-81` | The new `useTopbarOverlayElevation` / `useIsTopbarAboveOverlay` pair and the `createElevationHooks` refactor have no tests. `hooks/__tests__/useTopbarElevation.test.ts` wasn't updated and never mentions the overlay hooks. The only reference is a `jest.fn(() => false)` mock in `PageLayout/index.test.tsx:73`. Missing tests: register/unregister on open/close/unmount, and that the two stores stay independent. |
| 4 | TEST-02 | `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SafeSelectorDropdown/index.tsx` (`isDropdownActuallyOpen`), `apps/web/src/components/ui/select.tsx:109` | No test covers the new branches: the backdrop rendering only when `showBackdrop` is set, and elevation only when the dropdown is actually open. The disabled and `!canOpen` cases matter most, because a regression there leaves the topbar lifted above a backdrop that isn't shown. |
| 5 | TEST-02 | `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SafeAccounts/SpaceSafeContextMenu.tsx:39`, `:81` | New behaviour with no test (the component has no test file): the menu now anchors to `closest('tr')`, falls back to the button, and hides the backdrop. |
| 6 | TEST-02 | `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/Sidebar/SidebarTopBar/SidebarTopBar.tsx:36` | The new nested `isCollapsed` branch (a centred `size-10` logo tile) isn't covered. `__tests__/SidebarTopBar.test.tsx` wasn't touched. |
| 7 | CODE-02 | `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SafeSelectorDropdown/components/SafeRowStats.tsx:15` vs `apps/web/src/features/multichain/components/NetworkLogosList/styles.module.css:20` | The same crescent-mask geometry for stacked logos is written twice: once as a hard-coded inline JS string (`28px`, `12.5px`, `13px`) and once as a parameterised CSS rule. The CSS comment even says it "replicates … SafeRowStats … exactly". If one is tuned, the other won't follow. `SafeRowStats` could reuse the CSS-module class, or both could share one helper. |

**Low-confidence notes (not counted as failures):**
- **UI-01:** `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpacesList/AccountInfo.tsx:28` uses the raw palette class `text-green-500` rather than a theme token. The repo already does this in many places (e.g. `AccountsWidget.tsx:53`, `PendingTxWidget.tsx:56`), so it follows current practice.
- **UI-01:** the story decorator at `NetworkLogosList.stories.tsx:87` hard-codes `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)` instead of a token. It only affects Storybook.

## Rules that applied and passed
- **UI-01:** the new `lightHover` token was added to both palettes and the types, and the `vars.css` entries match in all three blocks.
- **UI-02:** `z-[calc(var(--z-overlay)+1)]` and the backdrop's `z-[var(--z-overlay)]` use the documented overlay layer (`--z-overlay: 1400`).
- **FEAT-01 / FEAT-03:** `AccountItemChainBadge` imports through `@/features/multichain`, and the new hooks live in shared `@/hooks`.
- **TEST-01 / TEST-02:** covered where tests exist: `AccountItemChainBadge` checks the 3×22px cap, and `SafeAccountsTable` checks dividers and embedded mode.
- **CODE-04:** `SafeRowStats` hoists `visibleChains`.
- **API-01:** the exported hook names and signatures are unchanged.

The rest (auth, RTK, chain, mobile, CI, transactions and similar) had nothing in this diff to check. I didn't need to look up any rule's review-learning history.
